acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision: either the limitation is accepted in CAL-V0-117 with its operator rule, or the token is monotonic and a test shows a restored older token no longer rebinds an old checkpoint.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session.

Observed 2026-10-07 in Codex review round 3 of V1-0645 (c05766af, PASS with this explicit limitation). The checkpoint carries the SHA-256 of the `.writer-checkpoint.invalidated` token current at publication; consumers use it only while the digests match. Deleting the token alone (absence is the empty token) or restoring an earlier token value can make an older checkpoint match again. The build log documents coordinated removal with no refresh running. Expected: decide whether to accept this as an operator-only limitation or make the token monotonic (for example a counter bound into the checkpoint, never reused). Suspected risk only; no failure observed.
title: V1-0645: writer checkpoint invalidation token is not rollback-resistant (deleting or restoring the token rebinds an old checkpoint)
